meta.name: allof-composition-custom-commands
meta.description: How to author custom commands for the allof-composition CLI using the co-generated SDK.

copy.tagline: 编写自定义命令扩展 CLI 功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 allof-composition CLI 中添加自定命令。
copy.tagline_en: Author custom commands to extend CLI functionality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add custom commands to the allof-composition CLI.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude能够指导你如何为 allof-composition CLI 编写自定义命令，包括注册命令、获取 SDK 客户端、执行异步调用等，并给出 Rust 代码示例。
howto.when: 当你询问如何编写 allof-composition 的自定义命令，或要求添加新命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 allof-composition 自定义命令，用来获取资源。
say.note: Claude 会给出注册命令和调用 SDK 的代码。

say.text: 如何在 allof-composition 里添加一个新命令？
say.note: Claude 会解释步骤并给出模板。

say.text: 写一个 allof-composition 命令，接收 ID 参数并查询资源。
say.note: Claude 会生成相应 Rust 代码。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to guide users in writing custom commands for the allof-composition CLI, including registering commands, obtaining the SDK client, and making async calls, with Rust code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about writing custom commands for allof-composition or request to add a new command.

say_en.text: Write an allof-composition custom command to fetch a resource.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the registration and SDK call code.

say_en.text: How to add a new command in allof-composition?
say_en.note: Claude explains the steps and gives a template.

say_en.text: Write a command that takes an ID and queries a resource.
say_en.note: Claude generates the corresponding Rust code.
